headline: Presentations covered the RSA 79-E tax relief program, a skills gap analysis, and a business recruitment and tourism plan.
summary: Planning Manager Sam Durfee presented RSA 79-E, a state law that gives owners temporary tax relief for qualifying improvements. Economic Development Director Liz Hannum presented a draft skills gap analysis and a business recruitment and tourism plan.
